title: How to Do the Dutty Wine | Reggae Dancehall | Chriss Choreo | How To Dance Jamaican

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor provides detailed, step-by-step guidance combined with professional physiotherapy and safety insights. She breaks down movements clearly, emphasizing proper posture, warm-up exercises, and personal body awareness.

lesson_structure.note: Host introduces herself and the channel
Explanation of the term Dutty Wine and its meaning in Jamaica
Demonstration of the dance movement with music
Physiotherapy safety tips and neck warm-up advice
Breakdown of half rotation and full rotation head movements

common_mistakes: Starting in heels when doing it for the first time
Wearing long earrings that could injure your neck or hair

steps_taught.name: Dutty Wine Warm-up
steps_taught.description: Neck and shoulder rolls to prepare for the dance

steps_taught.name: Half Rotation
steps_taught.description: Swinging head and hair half way across sides

steps_taught.name: Full Rotation
steps_taught.description: Full head and body rotation incorporating shoulders and hips

what_works: Gradual breakdown from warm-up to full movement
what_hinders: Fast movements with long hair can obstruct visibility

quotes.text: I'm a physiotherapist and so I must give you some tips on safety.
You're the only person who knows your body.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor stands in front of the camera in a bright room introducing the lesson.
Performs full body drops and dynamic head rolls to music.
Demonstrates neck turns and head tilts slowly from side to side.

extraction.distinctive_method: Integrating physiotherapy safety guidelines and personal body warnings before teaching head-heavy dancehall movements.
